 --> Prabhas gets a special birthday wish from Sandeep Reddy Vanga as director shares new picture from Spirit
 Prabhas and Sandeep Reddy Vanga share a new Spirit picture as their action drama gears up for Diwali 2027 release. 
 Vaishnavi Gavankar 
 October 23, 2026 / 19:35 IST Share --> 
 --> 
 --> 
 --> 
 Prabhas birthday 
 entPrabhas and director Sandeep Reddy Vanga have shared a new candid picture from their upcoming action drama Spirit, adding to the anticipation surrounding the film. The much-awaited project, also starring Triptii Dimri and Vivek Oberoi, is scheduled for a theatrical release on October 20, 2027, coinciding with Diwali.
 Prabhas and filmmaker Sandeep Reddy Vanga are gearing up for their first collaboration, Spirit, one of the most anticipated upcoming Indian films. As work on the project continues, the makers have released a candid photograph featuring the actor and director together, drawing attention to their upcoming action drama.
 View this post on Instagram A post shared by Sandeep Reddy Vanga (@sandeepreddy.vanga) 
 The picture shows Prabhas and Sandeep posing with a bottle of alcohol, offering a glimpse of their off-screen camaraderie. The photograph has added to the promotional buzz surrounding the film, which is being mounted on a large scale.

 Director Prashanth Neel meets Prabhas ahead of his birthday; Salaar 2 makers tease reunion with 'vio... 
 The newly released photograph captures a relaxed moment between Prabhas and Sandeep Reddy Vanga as they work on Spirit.
 The image also brings back memories of the film's earlier 'Ajanubahu' first-look poster, which had offered audiences an initial glimpse of Prabhas' appearance in the project.
 While the makers have kept major details about the storyline under wraps, the latest update has once again put the spotlight on the collaboration between the actor and filmmaker.
 Sandeep, known for directing Arjun Reddy, Kabir Singh and Animal, is returning with another action-driven story, this time featuring Prabhas in the lead.
 Apart from Prabhas, Spirit features Triptii Dimri and Vivek Oberoi in prominent roles.
 The film is described as a raw action cop drama, with the makers promising an intense cinematic experience.
 Although specific details about the characters have not been disclosed, the project is expected to feature the dramatic storytelling and action elements associated with Sandeep Reddy Vanga's filmmaking style.
 The combination of Prabhas, Triptii Dimri and Vivek Oberoi has added to the interest surrounding the film's cast.
 Spirit is scheduled to arrive in theatres on October 20, 2027, during the Diwali festive period.
 The film is being produced by Bhadrakali Pictures and T-Series on a large scale. According to the makers, production is progressing as planned ahead of its theatrical release.
 Also Read:  Karan Johar to host ELITE Most Influential 2026 at Oxford University on December 14  
 The project marks the first collaboration between Prabhas and Sandeep Reddy Vanga, bringing together two prominent names in Indian cinema.
 With its release date announced and filming underway, Spirit remains a major upcoming project for both the actor and director.
 The latest candid photograph offers another promotional update as audiences await further details about the film's storyline, characters and action sequences.
 Vaishnavi Gavankar is a senior entertainment journalist with over 8 years of experience covering Bollywood, Television, OTT platforms, and regional cinema.
